content: Both of my stock idlers (Core 1 original) are labeled 'R'. It doesn't seem to matter - just orient the idler like the photo - the flatish side near the back of the printer.

replies.content: Mine both have an L on one side and an R on the other. I wonder if it’s not that there’s a left and right idler, but each has a left and right side

content: Now is a good time to lube the tensioner screw to avoid galling if your C1 is part of the first wave. This step was added shortly after release.
